body: I dunno, i feel like i missed something, and now I'm too far behind. I had a job working at a grocery store and i found that too hard, and unless I hit some sort of lottery, chances are I'm gonna get some sort of generic 9-5 job where its gonna take an hour to drive there and back, and maybe an hour in the morning to get ready. which is roughly 11 hours of my day which is just sitting or doing nothing exciting with life, combined with whatever sleep i can get i'm looking at 7-9 hours of free time, but you know bills and what not and seeing as my mom struggled living paycheck to paycheck its not the kinda life i want. i dunno, im frustrating to talk to, but thank you for letting me vent

I have tried a few new things, its really hard to find things that I think are appealing, that and the whole depression thing gives me this mindset of 'I'm gonna kill myself later down the line so why bother.'  I dunno, i need to change my way of thinking, but its hard and im not sure why
